title: Real Research Today: VR University Campuses 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind VR University Campuses 2.0.
description:
The road to VR University Campuses 2.0 is already being paved. Micro-credentials (EU, Coursera, edX) unbundle degrees into verifiable skill units. Finland's phenomenon-based learning reorganizes school around topics, not subjects.

Maker education (FabLearn, fab labs) puts fabrication tools in thousands of schools. Together these programs form the virtual quads foundation that VR University Campuses 2.0 will build on — the campus logistics results, the accreditation methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as campus logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: VR University Campuses 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for VR University Campuses 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for VR University Campuses 2.0 — next-gen full universities in VR.

Phase 1 — Prove (virtual quads): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (campus logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (accreditation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (social presence): campus hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and students-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
